lines.trans: Mom and Dad, I want to drink a toast to you.
Thanks to Dad, who organized all of this.
Friends, excuse me for being a little late.
No big deal, the main thing is that you are here.
Friends, I also have a toast.
Our dear guest has not tried my cake.
But tonight I am going to fix that!
This is for you for deceiving my daughter!
Dad, explain quickly, what is going on here?
He is fooling around upstairs with other girls!
And at the same time he is stringing our daughter along!
Why did you cause this loud scandal?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'with / from', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Тебе ещё не надоела серая Москва?
examples.trans: Are you not tired of gray Moscow yet?

examples.text: Может, поедешь со мной в Париж?
examples.trans: Maybe you will go to Paris with me?

examples.text: Или тебя здесь что-то держит?
examples.trans: Or is something keeping you here?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('other, another, different').

examples.text: Хорошо, что паспорт лежал в другом кармане.
examples.trans: It is a good thing my passport was in another pocket.

examples.text: Пускают одного явно, а другого тайно.
examples.trans: They send one openly, and another secretly.

examples.text: Он там наверху с другими девушками гуляет!
examples.trans: He is fooling around upstairs with other girls!

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'girl, young woman, girlfriend' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Он там наверху с другими девушками гуляет!
examples.trans: He is fooling around upstairs with other girls!

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

examples.text: Это моя девушка Лёля.
examples.trans: This is my girlfriend Lyolya.

meanings.en: to walk, to stroll, to be outside
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'walks, is walking', paired with 'погулять'.

examples.text: Пойду лучше спокойно прогуляюсь на улице.
examples.trans: I will go take a quiet walk outside instead.

examples.text: Он там наверху с другими девушками гуляет!
examples.trans: He is fooling around upstairs with other girls!

examples.text: Там гуляет девочка с собачкой.
examples.trans: A girl walks a little dog there.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: И одновременно морочит голову нашей дочери!
examples.trans: And at the same time he is stringing our daughter along!

examples.text: Костя сказал это совершенно одновременно и спокойно.
examples.trans: Kostya said this quite at the same time and calmly.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'tricks / strings along'.

examples.text: И одновременно морочит голову нашей дочери!
examples.trans: And at the same time he is stringing our daughter along!

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и морочить вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and tricks on time.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'head' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Сынок, ты бы сначала головой думал.
examples.trans: Son, you should have used your head first.

examples.text: И одновременно морочит голову нашей дочери!
examples.trans: And at the same time he is stringing our daughter along!

examples.text: У меня болит голова.
examples.trans: I have a headache.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'why', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Зачем же она такого человека выбрала?
examples.trans: Why then did she choose a man like you?

examples.text: Зачем ты устроил этот громкий скандал?
examples.trans: Why did you cause this loud scandal?

examples.text: Зачем ты пришёл?
examples.trans: What have you come for?

meanings.en: to arrange, organize, set up an event or scheme
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'строить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to arrange, organize, set up', paired with 'устраивать'.

examples.text: Я хотел сегодня прощальный банкет устроить.
examples.trans: I wanted to throw a farewell banquet today.

examples.text: Зачем ты устроил этот громкий скандал?
examples.trans: Why did you cause this loud scandal?

examples.text: Я всё устрою на высшем уровне.
examples.trans: I will arrange everything at the highest level.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronominal determiner meaning 'this', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Слышишь, это сработала пожарная сигнализация.
examples.trans: Listen, the fire alarm has gone off.

examples.text: Ничего страшного, это просто красное вино.
examples.trans: No big deal, it is just red wine.

examples.text: Что это за внеплановый семейный совет?
examples.trans: What is this unscheduled family council?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('loud').

examples.text: Зачем ты устроил этот громкий скандал?
examples.trans: Why did you cause this loud scandal?

examples.text: Ты по громкой связи со мной говоришь?
examples.trans: Are you talking to me on speakerphone?

examples.text: Я услышал громкий голос.
examples.trans: I heard a loud voice.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'кандал'). Common masculine noun meaning 'scandal, fuss, row' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Зачем ты устроил этот громкий скандал?
examples.trans: Why did you cause this loud scandal?

examples.text: В зале ресторана начался скандал.
examples.trans: A scandal began in the restaurant dining room.

examples.text: Не нужно устраивать скандал.
examples.trans: There is no need to make a scene.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'any', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Дочь мне дороже любой звезды!
examples.trans: My daughter is dearer to me than any star!

examples.text: В любой момент.
examples.trans: Any time.

examples.text: Любой человек это знает.
examples.trans: Anyone knows that.

meanings.en: star (in the sky, hotel rating, or famous person)
meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'star' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Я первый в России получу звезду!
examples.trans: I will be the first in Russia to get a star!

examples.text: Дочь мне дороже любой звезды!
examples.trans: My daughter is dearer to me than any star!

examples.text: Ты никогда заветную звезду не получишь!
examples.trans: You will never get the coveted star!
